contentItem.title: 直线角：由两条直线组成的角
contentItem.englishTitle: And when the lines containing the angle are straight, the angle is called rectilineal.

surfaces.text: And when the lines containing the angle are straight, the angle is called rectilineal.
当包含角度的线条是直线时, 角度就叫做直线。
